claim_boundary: Post-schema-repair public-label one-pool transport development only; V1 remains a CANNOT_CHECK binding failure and no V2 model outcome existed at this freeze.

determinism.active_batch_selection: fit on all screened labels, rank remaining inclusion probabilities descending, reveal the next full batch in rank order, then refit
determinism.initial_seed_order: included seed first, excluded seed second
determinism.random_permutation: Python random.Random(seed).shuffle applied to the deterministic non-seed order
determinism.static_centroid: cosine similarity to the included seed under the shared L2-normalized TF-IDF representation

execution_scope: Generate a complete deterministic ordering for each arm; no post-outcome controller change is permitted under this identity.

metrics.fraction_screened_at_95_recall: one-indexed position of the ceil(0.95 * total_included)-th included record divided by N
metrics.random_arm_aggregation: arithmetic mean of each metric over the 20 frozen permutations
metrics.recall_budget_rounding: ceil(fraction * N), including the shared initial seed

parsing.canonical_subset: after excluding the incident row, exclude noncanonical class literals; among canonical class-free identity collisions retain the earliest raw line
parsing.excluded_first_row_hash_rule: sha256 of the first raw line after line-ending removal
parsing.field_rule: split the remaining raw line on literal tab and require exactly five fields
parsing.line_endings: remove one terminal LF and an immediately preceding CR, if present
parsing.record_identity_rule: sha256 of title, PMID, abstract and MeSH joined by literal tab; class excluded
